subject: Clarifying export slices and residency for audit/access logs (legal hold request)
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@clearwave.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal Team <legal-team@clearwave.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: export slices and residency for audit logs (legal hold)

Hi Marcus —

We're working on a preservation request from our compliance team and need a clear statement of what you can deliver for audit and access logs belonging to our tenant. Specifically: 

• Can you export a time-bounded slice (2025-06-01 to 2026-06-30) that includes every audit_event and access_trace for the tenant?
• Can exports be scoped by region (EU-only) and exclude any backups stored in other regions?
• What retention metadata is included (ingest timestamps, deletion tombstones, tenant_id, region tags)?
• We may need a certificate of destruction after the export. What's Redwood's standard process and SLA for that?

We have a regulatory deadline in 2 weeks for the preservation notice. Please let me know feasibility and any information you need from us (time windows, sample IDs, signed POA, etc.).

Thanks,
Lydia Park
Director, Regulatory Compliance
ClearWave Health

Subject: Re: Request: export slices and residency for audit logs (legal hold)

Hi Lydia —

Thanks for the clear ask and the deadline. Short answer: we can provide a region-scoped export and a destruction attestation, but there are a couple of operational constraints I want to confirm before we lock ETA: 

1) Export window: you asked for 2025-06-01 to 2026-06-30. Is that inclusive of timezone-normalized timestamps (i.e., do you want UTC boundaries)?

2) Object scope: do you need all event payloads (full JSON blobs) or a redacted export (headers + metadata only)? Full payloads increase export size and require a different delivery method (signed S3 transfer vs. Drive link).

3) Residency filter: we can filter by the region tag we maintain on the tenant's traces. If any data was geo-replicated for redundancy, we will exclude replicas outside EU but only if the primary tenant residency flag is EU and you confirm you do not need replicas.

4) Certificate of destruction: we provide an attestation PDF once customer confirms successful ingest on their side and after a 30-day hold period during which we do not purge the exported slice. If you require immediate purge post-transfer, we can escalate and produce a deletion certificate within 72 hours subject to a contractual SLA.

I'll loop in Hannah to propose the export format and an estimated timeline. Can you share a contact on your side who will confirm receipt and sign the acceptance?

Best,
Marcus
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 13:22:00 +00:00
Subject: Proposed plan: EU-only audit/access log export for ClearWave

Team —

Summary of what I recommend we offer (to be confirmed with Lydia):

1) Format & packaging
   - NDJSON stream for event payloads plus a companion CSV manifest (audit_export_manifest.csv) with record-level metadata: event_id, tenant_id, ingest_ts_utc, region_tag, retention_tag, tombstone_flag.
   - For large exports we'll do chunked signed S3 URLs (EU region) and provide MD5 checksums.

2) Scope & filters
   - Time window: 2025-06-01T00:00:00Z — 2026-06-30T23:59:59Z (UTC). Confirm if ClearWave wants inclusive/exclusive boundaries.
   - Region: filter on region_tag==EU. We will not include cross-region replicas.
   - Redaction: default = full payload. If legal asks for redacted, we'll run a redact pass (PII token removal) which adds 2–3 business days.

3) SLA & destruction
   - Standard: hold export files for 30 days after delivery, then purge copies and issue destruction certificate within 72 hours of purge completion.
   - Expedited: same-day purge + certificate within 72 hours available as a paid add-on with approval from Sales (need PO/contract).

4) Evidence & audit trail
   - We will include an index file with checksums, an access_log_sample_20260601.json (sample of the schema), and a delivery log showing which Redwoods services created each file.

I estimate we can produce the initial export package within 7 business days after receipt of signed POA and confirmation on the UTC window. If we need to run a redact pass, add 2–3 days.

Next actions: Marcus — if you agree, send Lydia the proposed UTC window and ask for the ClearWave receipt contact and POA. Karthik/Marissa — FYI for approval on expedited purge pricing if they choose that.

Thanks,
Hannah
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference
